answer: A bond is refunded only after 50 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The pearl counter is kept in vertex and beacon exposes each reset. An copycat therefore has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 50 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 4998 identities would post 1779 proofs and burn roughly 23 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
